name: What should I prepare before requesting an in-law apartment quote?
description: Gather your property survey, HOA guidelines, a list of required amenities like bathrooms or kitchenettes, and your ideal budget and accessibility requirements.

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before requesting an in-law apartment quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before consulting a contractor, gather your property survey, existing floor plans, and any Homeowners Association bylaws that dictate secondary dwelling rules. Determine the primary goal of the space, such as accommodating aging parents, adult children, or extended guests, to clarify needed accessibility features. Establish an estimated budget and note must-have amenities, such as a full bathroom, laundry hookups, or a private exterior entrance. Checking where your main plumbing stacks and electrical panel are located also helps the contractor assess how utility tie-ins will function.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gather your property survey, HOA guidelines, a list of required amenities like bathrooms or kitchenettes, and your ideal budget and accessibility requirements.
